messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from the vendor outages this week. Focusing on cloud provider rate limiting + model-registry spikes. I captured action owners and verification steps below — please ack and add any missing dependencies.

dylan: ack. can you share the concrete validation plan? want to make sure perf team is looped.

maria: Actions (owner -> target):
- cross-region read replicas for registry + deterministic manifest pinning (irene) -> 2026-04-08
- provider-rate-limit backoff + token rotation guardrails at gateway (tom) -> 2026-04-06
- SLA escalation doc + vendor contact runbook (maria) -> 2026-03-31
- automated smoke tests that simulate provider 429s and registry timeouts (dylan) -> 2026-04-04
- incident-patterns query + weekly digest for recurring vendor-related incidents (maria) -> 2026-04-02

irene: For replicas I'll include fast manifest checksums to avoid full downloads; planning staggered propagation windows. if teams need immediate strong read-after-write I'll add a write-affinity header.

tom: Gateway changes: implementing exponential backoff + jitter and token rotation guard to avoid stampede on token refresh. also adding a short-lived in-memory token cache for surge protection.

dylan: Smoke tests plan: use locust script to inject 429s + TCP blackhole for registry; will produce latency graphs and alert thresholds. will post test harness and results.

oncall-bot: Reminder: open issue in infra-incidents with label vendor-mitigation and link to this thread.

maria: I'll open infra-incidents/PR-#### and assign. Also proposing we add a field in the incident tracker for "vendor escalation started" timestamp.

irene: migration note: ensure the model-serving clients accept manifest v2 header; will list clients and a fallback header compatibility shim.

maria: Verification steps (for each action):
- run chaos test simulating us-west-2 registry latency spike -> services should failover to replica within 12s
- hit gateway with token refresh latencies and verify cache prevents >80% refresh errors
- run weekly digest and confirm any cluster of vendor incidents over 30 days surfaces an owner

tom: quick patch deployed to staging. test command: ```
# simulate provider 429s
python tools/simulate_vendor_errors.py --target registry --mode 429 --duration 300
```

dylan: I'll schedule the staging runs and attach dashboards. ETA for first run: 2026-03-29.

maria: Checkpoint sync scheduled: 2026-03-30 09:00 PT to review staging results, PRs, and vendor escalation doc. If anyone slips on ETA, update the infra-incidents issue and ping oncall.

oncall-bot: Action required: assign owners in infra-incidents and set "due_date" field for each action.

maria: Thanks all. Closing loop: please avoid discussing unrelated topics in this thread — keep updates in infra-incidents issue so we have a single source of truth.
